finding.expected: Do not infer executor_invoked from the configured Executor selector. Emit executor_invoked=true only when an existing authoritative observation directly proves invocation for that exact delivery/RUN; otherwise leave it false or omit the claim according to the bounded receipt contract. Do not add a new lifecycle authority or widen dispatch-journal semantics. Add a regression with an exact journal-bound RUN before dispatcher invocation proving the receipt does not claim Executor invocation.
finding.issue: RUN_ATTRIBUTED and TERMINAL_POINTER receipts set executor_invoked from record.get('executor') is not None. PRIMARY/correction/REPAIR dispatch journals record the selected Executor before execution, and RUN binding occurs at canonical admission before dispatcher invocation. Executor selection or RUN attribution therefore does not prove that the Executor was actually invoked, so the receipt can overstate an unobserved boundary fact.
